description: The first metatarsal builds the sturdy medial column of the forefoot, letting artists anchor balance and express the big toe's push-off.

landmarks.name: Base of the first metatarsal
landmarks.desc: Proximal wedge that braces against the medial cuneiform and anchors powerful arch tendons.

landmarks.name: Medial shaft surface
landmarks.desc: Long medial plane that catches light in dorsiflexed poses and defines the inner arch.

landmarks.name: Head of the first metatarsal
landmarks.desc: Rounded distal head that pairs with the proximal phalanx to drive the big toe's expressive push.
